cards.title: Handling of Failed Lambda Z Estimation
cards.claim: When Lambda Z cannot be estimated (due to insufficient points, non-negative slope, or invalid time range), Phoenix omits the curve fit for that subject. However, parameters independent of Lambda Z (Cmax, Tmax, AUClast) are still reported. A warning is issued in the text output indicating Lambda Z was not estimable.
conditions: Automatic range selection requested but insufficient points.
limitations: Extrapolated AUC (AUCinf) and terminal half-life cannot be calculated.
Interpretation of terminal phase is not possible for that subject.
cards.downstream_use: Guides interpretation of incomplete PK profiles. Researchers must decide whether to exclude these subjects or rely on partial exposure metrics (AUClast).

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
